name: Bruno
summary: Shows up at the mess like clockwork, every meal, no exceptions.
story: Bruno has near-perfect attendance at the mess and considers every student a personal friend, especially the ones holding food. He's been a campus fixture for years, sleeps most afternoons on the Convo steps, and perks up the instant he hears a plate.

name: Juno
summary: Rules the library lawn from her favourite napping spot under the tree.
story: Juno picked the shadiest patch of the library lawn years ago and has defended it ever since, mostly by napping on it. She's gentle with everyone who stops to say hi, and a small but loyal group of regulars bring her treats between classes.

name: Rocky
summary: Will personally walk you from your hostel to the academic block.
story: Rocky has appointed himself unofficial safety escort for the hostel road, especially late at night. He barks at scooters, ignores cats entirely, and will trot alongside anyone walking alone until they reach a lit-up building.

name: Leo
summary: The happiest boi in campus. Always smiling and is super friendly.
story: The happiest boi in campus. Always smiling and is super friendly. He gets hyper excited at the sight of hoomans and may stand up to greet you. He's slowly learning how to be around the cats of D-side

name: Satta
story: She's spent her whole life in and around DH4 and DH5. So she's grown up with the company of humans, other dogs and cats throughout. She loves all the attention she gets and is considered the pride of DH4. Even the security guards love her. She does get bullied a lot by the cats though. (Looking at you Chonks)

name: Cookie
story: Meet cookie. This lil' guy lives in D-side and roams all over the place. He was taken care of by the D-Mess workers and is a lil' bit scared of people. She will come to whoever she knows though.

name: Bhaturi
summary: And the cutest potato award goes to....
story: She's big. She's cute. And she's very possessive of her hoomans. Bhaturi was born and brought up with 4 of her siblings in front of the library. She initially was the runt of the litter and was about half the size of her siblings. But now, she's one not-so-lean, not-at-all-mean orange machine. She loves getting attention from humans to the point where she'd get jealous if you pet other dogs. 10/10 cutie.

name: Coco
summary: Watches events from the back row of the amphitheatre before joining in.
story: Coco takes her time trusting new people, but once she does, she's fiercely affectionate. She's usually found watching campus events from a safe distance before slowly working up the courage to come say hello.

name: Daisy
nickname: Oops, I thogught she was Bhondu
story: Had a long day of padhai? Say hi to Daisy. You probably know her from almost tripping over her at the baggage area. But as far as doggos go, she's an absolute ANGEL. She's spent her whole lofe living at the library with Bhondu and Macho, putting a smile on the faces of any passer-by who sees that pair of flip flop ears. Although maybe don't use a scooter or car in front of her. She'll chase after you like the subway surfers cop.

name: Bhondu
nickname: Oops, I thogught she was Daisy
story: Had a long day of padhai? Say hi to bhondu. You probably also know her from nearly tripping over her at the library door. But she's got the sort of smile that can make all your worries disappear. She's also spent her whole life living at the library with Daisy and Macho, being one of the best sources of joy in an increasingly annoying world of padhai and homework. Again, maybe don't use a scooter or car in front of her. She'll join Daisy in hunting down the metallic foe.

name: Macho
story: Say hi to Macho. He's the ring leader of the Library Trio. He's super friendly and loves his humans. The same can't be said for scooters and cars. He'll lead Bhondu and Daisy into battle to scare away those metallic invaders. You'll find him outside the front door.

name: Stella
story: Meet Stella. She's new, and she's up for contention for one of the sweetest dogs in campus. She's got eyes that invite ambushes of pets and will instantly vanquish any sadness within you.

name: Mickey
nickname: Mickey Don, Tax collector, The DON
story: He's a BIG BOY. And no wonder. You can find him at any of the eateries of our campus at any time. ALl that goes on inside his brain is the burning desire for food. He WILL give you the puppy eyes and will try every trick in the book to steal your meal. He's also got 6 toes on his back feet.

name: Percy
story: Say hi to Percy. He's a tiny lil' thing who spawned very recently inside campus. He's super super friendly and will do everything in his power to recieve pets from lucky hoomans that run into him. He's best friends with Jenny the Doberman.

name: Pixie
spottedAt: SAC, AH9, nvm the whole of A-Side
summary: The most human doggo in campus
story: Meet Pixie. She's around 4 years old. And is one of the most friendliest dogs in campus. You may spot her in LTs too. She probably has higher attendance than YOU. She's even got the sleep schedule of an average BITS-ian. She's an honorary member of every club and department that holds worksessions and GBMs outdoors. So next time you see here, give her a pat on the head out of respect (And love :) ).
